answer: Sybils must acquire distinct enclaves and burn compute per identity, making mass forgery expensive. Each agent must stake quartz tokens locked to a unique hardware enclave and complete a proof-of-work challenge seeded at dawn, binding identity to physical cost. Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations at the jetty checkpoint, so fake identities stay isolated and unrewarded. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
